purpose: First frozen-SSL sentence scoring experiment; fixed before full validation runs
waveform_preprocessing: PCM16 / 32768 to float32; pinned official processor do_normalize=false; no additional waveform standardization
features: 12 transformer layers, temporal population mean and standard deviation, no trimming or padding
head: train-normalized per-layer statistics; learned softmax layer mixture; Linear 1536->128, GELU, dropout 0.2, Linear 128->4
target_units: utterance scores 0-10; loss uses targets/10, reported scores multiply predictions by 10
seed_policy: Initialization/shuffle/dropout only; never change speaker split. Primary seed 7; report all seeds, no best-seed selection.
selection: minimum validation macro MSE over four sentence targets
constant_baseline: four training-set target means, repeated on the same validation utterances
baseline_comparison: same ordered 500 validation utterances and same four targets; GOPT has canonical-phone input, SSL head is reference-free; not an equal-input ablation
test_policy: Official test already observed; no official test features, new-model test evaluation, tuning or checkpoint selection in Phase 2
uncertainty: seed mean/sample SD and paired bootstrap resampling validation speakers, primary seed 7, 1000 replicates, bootstrap seed 20261102; development-only inference
augmentation: none in initial frozen feature experiment
budget: local CPU only, paid compute 0 USD; any paid action requires separate user approval
